posts.name: distribution.dev
posts.tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
posts.description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

posts.name: Granular.Build
posts.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
posts.description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

posts.name: Clam AI
posts.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
posts.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

posts.name: Viktor Code
posts.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
posts.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

posts.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
posts.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
posts.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

posts.name: frwrd.to
posts.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
posts.description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

posts.name: Claude Ship
posts.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
posts.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

posts.name: Kodak SlideTag
posts.tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
posts.description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

posts.name: tday.com
posts.tagline: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos
posts.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

posts.name: Valley
posts.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
posts.description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

posts.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
posts.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
posts.description: We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

posts.name: doola MCP
posts.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
posts.description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

posts.name: Pinned
posts.tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends
posts.description: Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

posts.name: Astor
posts.tagline: AI Thesis Investing
posts.description: Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

posts.name: Fleetify
posts.tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents
posts.description: Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

posts.name: Willow iOS 2.0
posts.tagline: No switching apps while you dictate
posts.description: Tap the mic and talk without leaving the app you’re writing in. Willow brings dictation and Scribe into your iPhone keyboard, alongside swipe typing, smarter autocorrect, emoji, and cursor control. Speak a longer thought, type a quick edit, and keep going.

posts.name: HeroUI Pro 1.0
posts.tagline: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React
posts.description: HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

posts.name: Drift
posts.tagline: Wallpaper that reflects the world around you
posts.description: Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

posts.name: Mystonie
posts.tagline: Log movies, shows, books & games — turn finishes into art
posts.description: Mystonie is a free, ad-free journal for everything you finish: movies, TV shows, books, manga, and games. Turn every finish into shareable artwork cards, explore your World Atlas, search movies by plot, play daily movie games, and add Android widgets.

posts.name: Finseo
posts.tagline: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI
posts.description: Finseo now acts on your AI visibility, not just measures it. Company Brain puts your website, docs, Drive, Search Console, GA4 and AI tracking into one searchable map: ask anything, get answers with sources. Outreach finds the pages AI answers cite where your brand is missing, finds the editors and drafts pitches in your brand voice, with every claim checked against your Brain before you approve.

posts.name: Juncts
posts.tagline: Superhuman for your DMs, with AI that triages and drafts
posts.description: Juncts centralizes LinkedIn, X, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram into one powerful, keyboard-first inbox, then lets AI do the heavy lifting. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to catch up on what you missed, triage and label conversations, and draft replies across every app. Labels, reminders, scheduled messages, split views and CRM sync built in. You set the AI's access level, and nothing sends unless you allow it. 14 days free, no card.

posts.name: Umami Manager
posts.tagline: Umami reports, widgets & links – native on iPhone & iPad
posts.description: Umami Manager 3.0 brings your Umami analytics to iPhone and iPad – cloud or self-hosted. New in 3.0: in-depth reports like events, sessions, compare, breakdown, attribution, Web Vitals, errors and realtime, links and pixels in their own tabs, widgets for any website, link, pixel and metric, and multiple windows on iPad and iPhone Duo. Manage websites, teams and users across accounts. Native and privacy-first – try it free for 7 days.

posts.name: Almma's PII Guard
posts.tagline: Catch personal data before it reaches your AI chat
posts.description: A free, open-source browser extension that flags names, emails, numbers, dates and addresses in the message box of claude.ai and chat.almma.ai, and replaces them with placeholders like [NAME_1] before you send. Pasted text is held for review. Typed text is underlined in red and Send is blocked until you decide. Everything runs locally: the code contains no network calls, and the README shows how to check. MIT licensed.

posts.name: mindyOne
posts.tagline: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.
posts.description: mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

posts.name: Cullman
posts.tagline: Faster voice agent evals, from simulation to production
posts.description: Cullman is an evals platform for building and shipping reliable voice agents. Evaluate every prompt, model, and voice change with text simulations, voice simulations, and real human testers, scored against your custom rubrics. Compare versions, catch regressions, and validate improvements before you deploy. Run simulations in minutes and human tests in days. Then keep evaluating in production with live-call scoring, call traces, and split tests. Test, deploy, and improve your agent in one place.

posts.name: Scribase MCP Server
posts.tagline: A Postgres backend your coding agent sets up by MCP
posts.description: Scribase MCP Server gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Zed and VS Code 97 tools over a hosted Postgres backend: database, auth, storage, realtime and functions. The agent creates the project, runs SQL and migrations, and writes the keys into your app. Reads run at once; destructive changes wait for your confirm, and schema changes can be gated on a passing row-level-security test. Remote server, nothing to run. Free for 14 days, no card, then from $5 a project.

posts.name: Tendor
posts.tagline: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows
posts.description: Write down a thought or ask AI without leaving what you're doing. Press a hotkey and Tendor opens over any app on Windows 11. Type to save a task or note, start with ? to ask AI, or ?! to send your screen too. The AI reads your tasks and notes from any day, asking before it opens an older one. Save instructions as Skills and run them with /name, or type /newskill and the AI writes one. Use your own key from 8 providers. Plain Markdown, no account, free to start.

posts.name: TouchDeck
posts.tagline: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a control deck for your Mac
posts.description: TouchDeck turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a control deck for your Mac: keys, rotary dials, sliders and a jog wheel. Pick any Mac app and it builds a deck from the shortcuts in that app's own menus, and your deck switches by itself when you change apps. One key can run a whole workflow. Pairs with a 4-digit code over local Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account. The Mac app is free; 7-day free trial on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: Context
posts.tagline: The calendar that gets you ready for every meeting
posts.description: Context brings your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars together, understands what you type, and before every meeting tells you who you are seeing, what you talked about and what was left open.

posts.name: K-Stra
posts.tagline: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths
posts.description: Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.

posts.name: Bento terminal
posts.tagline: A multi-pane terminal workspace for one project
posts.description: Bento is a full-screen terminal workspace for one project: preview and edit files, review changes, run builds, open a shell, and run coding agents beside the preview. No more multi-tab terminal juggling — one Bento window holds the workspace, with shell tabs inside. Let your AI agent do the work while you watch changes in real time, see what is staged for git, and run tests while the dev server keeps running. In-app updates. Single Go binary, MIT, macOS, Linux, Windows.

posts.name: Astrolabio
posts.tagline: Your AIs pick up right where you left off, on your Mac
posts.description: Every new AI chat starts from scratch. Astrolabio keeps a notebook for each project: status, decisions, rules, to-dos. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Antigravity read it on their own and keep it updated. Stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Ohhai
posts.tagline: Type messy, send clean: an AI keyboard for iPhone
posts.description: Ohhai is an AI keyboard for iPhone. Type fast, mistakes and all, and Return puts in the clean phrase. Or talk, or translate into over 40 languages, in any app. Stuck on a reply? Press the Action Button for three drafts. You always press send.

posts.name: Adanotch
posts.tagline: A live Dynamic Island for your MacBook notch
posts.description: Adanotch turns the MacBook notch into a live island: music, meetings, a file shelf with offline conversion, OCR and screen recording. It also shows AI agent approvals and usage limits for Claude, Codex and more. Native Swift, no account, 2-day free trial.

posts.name: LayAuto 4
posts.tagline: Find any window, tab, or session on your Mac
posts.description: LayAuto 4 is a window manager for Apple silicon Macs. Search and jump to any window, browser tab, terminal session, or project; group them by context; restore layouts automatically; and use two Macs as one workspace. Most features are free.

posts.name: Hourly Journal
posts.tagline: Journal your hours, understand your days
posts.description: Ever wondered where your entire day went? Hourly Journal helps you keep track of what you do, how you feel and how you spend your time. A quick check-in every hour helps you discover patterns, understand yourself better and be more intentional about your day. Available on iOS, Android and the web.

posts.name: DeskMagic
posts.tagline: Shake your cursor, ask AI about anything on screen
posts.description: DeskMagic is a Windows app that puts AI right next to whatever you're looking at. Shake your mouse, drag around a chart, error, email or foreign text, and the answer streams in beside it. Uses your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key with no DeskMagic servers in between, no account, and history saved only on your PC. Highlight text to skip the screenshot entirely.

posts.name: Prates
posts.tagline: Learns how you write, then writes exactly as you would
posts.description: Prates learns from what you write across any app: who you write to, your projects, your views and your wording. It turns speech into finished text, drafts replies and completes what you type. What it learns stays as short notes on your Mac that you can read or delete. Voice and text go only to the models you choose and have available, locally or in the cloud. macOS 14+. 7-day free trial, then $9.99 per month.

posts.name: Wellbreak
posts.tagline: Your wellbeing buddy in Mac's notch
posts.description: Wellbreak is a wellbeing buddy for your Mac. He lives in your notch and takes each break with you: look away, blink, stand, stretch, drink water, sit up tall. He waits while you type, steps aside on calls, and his face shows how your day is going. Pay once, no account, and your history stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Finer Screenshot
posts.tagline: Add text that automatically stays readable on any background
posts.description: It's faster to show than to tell. Text you add gets an outline and shadow that adapt to what's under it, so it stays readable on any background. Finer Screenshot opens in about 200 ms, and its redaction mosaic is drawn from made-up text, so there's nothing underneath to recover. $19.99 once, 14-day free trial. Mac now, Windows is coming soon.

posts.name: Rotara
posts.tagline: Mac workspaces, one flick away
posts.description: Each project gets its own windows. Switch and only that project is on screen, every window exactly where you left it, and Dock clicks and links open right there. A pie menu opens at your cursor and one flick takes you there, or use ⌃1–9 or a swipe. ⌘Tab shows only this project's apps and the pie sits on keys you already press, so it feels like part of macOS. Nothing to set up. 14 days free, then $19 once.

posts.name: InField
posts.tagline: Translate and refine text where you type, on Mac and Chrome
posts.description: Translating something usually means leaving it: open a translator or AI, paste, copy, come back, and paste again. InField skips the trip. Tap Shift twice in any text field on your Mac or in Chrome, and InField translates or polishes what you wrote. Tap Shift once more and replace it. Write in your language, the target one, or a mix of both, and get one clean text. Fix grammar, structure, and tone. Select text to translate it. InField detects the source language for you.

posts.name: Even G2 Enterprise SDK
posts.tagline: Build custom business apps for Even G2 smart glasses
posts.description: Connect Even G2 smart glasses directly to your own mobile applications with Flutter, native iOS and Android SDKs

posts.name: Sotto
posts.tagline: Hold a key, speak, clean text lands at your Linux cursor
posts.description: Open-source desktop dictation for Linux (Wayland & X11). Hold a shortcut in any terminal, editor, or browser, speak naturally, and Sotto transcribes with your own Groq Whisper or ElevenLabs key in ~600 ms, cleans up filler words, and pastes at your cursor.

posts.name: Flourish
posts.tagline: The AI coach helping you complete tasks & achieve your goals
posts.description: Most apps help you do more. Flourish helps you do what matters. Get everything out of your head, by voice or text, and Flourish helps you prioritise, plan your day around your calendar and turn bigger goals into manageable steps. Then starts doing them with you. It checks in to keep you moving, learns your priorities over time and adjusts with you when life changes, even if that means making today’s plan smaller. Less mental load. More room for life.

posts.name: QApilot Go - Play Policy Checker
posts.tagline: Know if Google Play will reject your app, before you submit
posts.description: Upload an APK or pick your app from the Play Store. QApilot Go crawls it on an Android emulator, scans the build, and checks it against 60+ Google Play policy rules. You get a readiness score, every blocker, and what to fix first, in your inbox.

posts.name: Oya Browser
posts.tagline: A real, logged-in browser for your AI agents
posts.description: AI agents break on real websites: they get logged out, stall at MFA, and burn tokens on every click. Oya gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client a real browser with persistent logins. Watch live and take over for MFA in one click. Record a workflow once, replay it with zero LLM calls, or export it as Playwright code. Scales from 1 to 1,000s of cloud browsers in under a minute, HIPAA compliant on Oya Cloud. Free desktop app.

posts.name: DR4 Checker by Construct Computer
posts.tagline: Your Ahrefs DR probably drops on Dec 1. See where it lands.
posts.description: Ahrefs switches Domain Rating to DR4 on December 1, and 88 of the 100 sites we checked score lower. Type up to five sites to see each one's DR4 next to its DR3, along with its Tranco rank and trend, domain age, first archived date, Wikipedia links and a malware check. Every number comes live from a free source and says where it came from, and you don't need an account. Agents can call it by URL, use it as a WebMCP tool on the page, or add our MCP server, which has all our free tools.

posts.name: Pinrom Go
posts.tagline: Run client work with your team, clients and freelancers
posts.description: Pinrom Go is a project tool for small teams and agencies doing client work. Tasks, kanban boards, chat, a wiki, files and time tracking live in one workspace. Clients see only the projects you share, minus anything you mark internal. Freelancers see only their own tasks. Client and freelancer seats are free. Assign work to people who haven't joined yet. Black Friday: first year from $9, ends Cyber Monday.

posts.name: AIVA for Shopify
posts.tagline: Your AI salesperson, live on your Shopify store 24/7
posts.description: AIVA knows your whole Shopify catalog, shows shoppers their options, compares two, and closes. Your customer just talks, like a phone call; AIVA is the one on screen. Every conversation lands in your admin as a lead with a recording, AI summary and transcript.

posts.name: Fencio
posts.tagline: Security for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
posts.description: Fencio stops your coding agent before it does something risky. Write a rule in plain language and it checks every action Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Copilot takes. Each one is Allowed or Blocked, and logged with the rule that decided. One command to install, connected in a few minutes.

posts.name: Carry
posts.tagline: Save every AI conversation. Find it. Continue anywhere.
posts.description: Carry saves your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok chats, with projects and files, as Markdown in Obsidian or any folder. Search every word, then open any chat in another AI and keep going. NO API - NO ACCOUNTS - NO SERVERS Product Hunt special: $25 off for the next 24 hours. Use code PRODUCTHUNT at checkout.

posts.name: Subgrow
posts.tagline: Your own subreddit, growing on autopilot
posts.description: People check Reddit before they buy, Google ranks Reddit threads, and AI assistants quote them. Subgrow opens a subreddit for your brand and writes one post a day in it, each answering a question your buyers search. You can edit or skip any post.

posts.name: KhelNayak
posts.tagline: QR games for cafés and restaurants
posts.description: Give guests something fun to do while they wait for their order. They scan a QR code at the table and play a quick browser game on their phones. Try a round of Tic-Tac-Toe in the sample café. KhelNayak works on its own; no ChefDesk or LoyaltyXchain account is required.

posts.name: Crowdsided
posts.tagline: The Would You Rather Game Where the Crowd Decides
posts.description: Play would you rather against the crowd. Pick a side, see how everyone voted, and score points for thinking like the crowd. New Daily 10 every day, no sign-up.

posts.name: PlanBrix
posts.tagline: Quotes, invoices and payments for freelancers, in one place
posts.description: PlanBrix is a web app for freelancers, creators and small creative agencies. Price work from your rate card, send quotes and invoices, track projects on a calendar and send payment reminders. Pola, the built-in AI assistant, drafts quotes, invoices and projects from a chat or your voice. Clients pay you directly; PlanBrix never holds your money. Free to start.

posts.name: Shipday
posts.tagline: A tiny Mac app that makes you post on LinkedIn daily
posts.description: Shipday nudges you until today's LinkedIn post is shipped. A paper plane floats on your screen, streaks and XP keep you going, and an AI coach that runs on your Mac reviews your draft but never writes it for you. Free.

posts.name: Airtable to Sheets
posts.tagline: Sync Airtable into Google Sheets and keep it up to date
posts.description: Pick an Airtable base, table or view and the records land in a Google Sheet. Sync by hand, every 3 hours, or live, with sheet edits sent back to Airtable. Linked records show by name. Plans from $9 a month after a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: A Novel Appetite Bookstore
posts.tagline: Ask a vampire anything. He answers twice a week.
posts.description: A secondhand bookshop run by Aspen, a four-hundred-year-old vampire. Browse 25 public-domain classics, each with his verdict. Every page funnels to Office Hours, his public AMA — he answers the winners live Tue & Thu at 1 PM Central. First session Dec 1.

posts.name: KaraDesk
posts.tagline: Customer support for the modern world
posts.description: Customer support assisted by your own AI agent. A shared inbox for chat and email, a messenger for web, iOS and Android, and help centers that work together, so your team can answer every customer faster.

posts.name: Bite100 Passport
posts.tagline: Track baby's first 100 foods, one passport stamp at a time
posts.description: A calm starting solids guide and food tracker, from first bites at 6 months to toddler meals at 3. Check off 100 first foods and earn a passport stamp for each one. Inside: 650+ foods with cut-by-age guides, 150+ short videos, a Top 9 allergen plan, 200+ baby and toddler recipes (family-table meals for 12–36 months), feeding schedules by month, 29 guides and 9 free tools. Works for BLW and purees. Reviewed by our dietitians, following AAP and NIAID guidance.

posts.name: BuilderBee
posts.tagline: Tech events for women and non-binary builders, worldwide
posts.description: BuilderBee is a free calendar of tech events for women and non-binary people: hackathons, buildathons, workshops, meetups and conferences, online and around the world. Made by @irina_csapo and @tracey_windsor after meeting at a hackathon and then struggling to find the next one. An AI scout built with Claude Code adds confirmed events every morning. Add it to your own calendar, get the weekly email every Monday, or find a group to join on the Communities page.

posts.name: Yepdid: Tasks for Two
posts.tagline: A shared to-do list made for Two
posts.description: Yepdid is a to-do list made for two. Give a task to your partner, take one yourself, or leave it for whoever gets there first. Done takes two ticks: one of you ticks it, the other says yep. Free: checklists, busy times side by side so deadlines land when someone is free, reminders and pokes. Yepdid+ adds routines, shared costs with settle up, photos and PDFs on tasks, and Google Calendar sync, with a 7-day free trial. On iPhone now, Google Play coming soon.

posts.name: Mole
posts.tagline: Research that arrives as a document you can defend
posts.description: AI assistants answer your questions confidently, but often incorrectly. They stop at the first plausible answer and don't go deep enough. Mole does. It traces all claims to their sources, uncovers the contradictions between those sources, and gets to the bottom of the facts. The result is a research report that is ready for you to rely on in professional, business, or academic settings where the facts and the numbers matter. Pay per report, from $10. The engine is open source.

posts.name: Brimlight
posts.tagline: Animated Menu Bar Themes & a 3D Pet for Mac
posts.description: Your menu bar is the strip of screen you look at all day, and it's always flat gray. Brimlight brings it to life. A 3D cat moves in: it hunts your cursor, chases yarn and naps when you step away. Play music and the bar becomes an equalizer while the cat dances. Pick from 41 living themes, from pixel-art sunsets to a sky that follows the real sun, and hang neon, garlands or sakura along the edge, even around the notch. Menus stay readable and clickable. Free forever. Pro is $6.99, once.

posts.name: AI STUDIOS 5.0
posts.tagline: Video Agent, Role Play & Interactive Coaching in one studio
posts.description: Just describe what you want: Video Agent writes the script, builds the scenes and adds the voice. AI STUDIOS 5.0 also brings Role Play and Interactive Coaching, with 2000+ realistic AI avatars and dubbing in 70+ languages with voice cloning.

posts.name: WhoCue
posts.tagline: Know who to meet at your next event, and what to say
posts.description: Make the most of your next conference or networking event. WhoCue helps you find people worth meeting based on your goals, recognize them by photo, and start conversations with personalized talking points. It’s like having a personal assistant who prepares attendee briefs you can pull up on your phone just before you walk up to someone. 100% free on iPhone, iPad, and Android. No WhoCue account, ads, or tracking.

posts.name: BatchDash
posts.tagline: An MRP built for formulas instead of parts
posts.description: Production software for food and cosmetic makers who work from recipes. Cost each batch from what you actually paid, plan it against real stock, run it from the recipe sheet, and trace any lot back to its delivery or forward to the customer.

posts.name: QuickFinds
posts.tagline: Scan any barcode, see the profit and where to buy it cheaper
posts.description: Other scanners show what an item sells for. Reseller Pro shows where to buy it cheapest. Scan any barcode for a BUY, MAYBE, or PASS rating, estimated profit after Amazon fees, eBay prices, sales rank, and price history. Compare prices across 100+ stores with coupons and cash back to maximize profit. First 3 scans free. Available on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: PixelWatcher
posts.tagline: Monitor the web for changes you care about.
posts.description: PixelWatcher is a website change monitoring service. Give it the URL of a webpage, describe the change you care about in plain English, and it notifies you when that change happens. No CSS selectors, scripts or rules required.

posts.name: Folkscale
posts.tagline: Test products with country-calibrated synthetic panels
posts.description: Folkscale tests a product, price or ad with a country-calibrated synthetic consumer panel. Panels are quota-sampled to the census and answer in first-person prose. SSR (arXiv:2510.08338) maps that text to a 5-point purchase-intent scale, with verbatims and a research brief. Built-in markets: US, UK, FI, DE, JP, BR and IN. New accounts get a $29 starter credit. $29 Quick Screen (up to 50 respondents, 1 concept), $149 Full Study, $499/mo Growth, $1,499/mo Agency. Research Studio, MCP or REST API.

posts.name: Mico
posts.tagline: A window switcher that fans out from the screen edge
posts.description: Mico is a macOS app that fans out your open windows from a screen edge. Replaces Mission Control + Cmd Tab.

posts.name: Gregale
posts.tagline: Next-generation cloud infrastructure for humans and agents.
posts.description: Bring APIs, services and background work onto one platform. Now out of beta!

posts.name: Wisssh
posts.tagline: Wisssh - Wishlists, Group Gifts & Gift Exchanges
posts.description: Organize Christmas gift exchanges with ease using Wisssh! Create a Gift Exchange, invite friends and family, randomly assign who buys for whom, and let participants use wishlists to find gifts their recipients will love. Beyond Secret Santa, Wisssh also lets you create wishlists for birthdays, weddings and special occasions, and bring people together to contribute towards bigger gifts through Circles.

posts.name: HeyZima
posts.tagline: A Chinese course made for you: read, write, listen, speak
posts.description: HeyZima is all of Chinese in one app: reading, writing, listening and speaking, with the dictionary built in. Its course is made as you go: every session is built from the words and grammar you've just learned, the ones you keep missing, and the ones about to slip. You practise on 98,285 real sentences written by people: read them, hear them, say them back and write them in pinyin. It tells you when you'll reach your next HSK level. Ten minutes a day is free. Android now, iPhone soon.

posts.name: Drag for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Your Gmail shared inbox, inside ChatGPT
posts.description: Now you can run your team's shared inbox straight from ChatGPT. Drag is live in ChatGPT's Plugin Directory. Inboxes like support@ get messy: emails get missed, two people reply to the same customer, and nobody knows what's still waiting. Drag turns them into shared boards inside Gmail, so everyone sees who's handling what. In ChatGPT, ask what needs a reply, assign emails to teammates and draft answers from your help center. Nothing sends without your OK. 7-day free trial, no card.

posts.name: Macapp.space
posts.tagline: Discover Mac apps & keep track of the ones that matter.
posts.description: Never miss a Mac app you meant to try. Mark apps you want or use, group them into collections, and come back to them later. Find the right Mac app for the job, even when you don’t know its name. Browse about 5,000 apps by category or topic, compare alternatives, and check price, macOS requirements and where to get each one on a single page. Makers list theirs for free.

posts.name: maverickbuilds.app
posts.tagline: Build planning, analytics & data apps with AI.
posts.description: Companies used to buy platforms from Oracle, IBM, SAP and others to build planning, analytics and data management apps. Now it's free for internal use with unlimited users and no license fees. Multidimensional models, interactive dashboards, role-based workflows, integrations, automations with MCP server and AI builder inside: everything you need to run budgets, forecasts, reports, HR plans, sales targets, CRM, Helpdesk and much more.

posts.name: Chameleon Icons
posts.tagline: Generate the icons your icon pack is missing
posts.description: Pick any icon sets. Icon missing? Generate it for free! Share with everyone. Use in code from npm.

posts.name: Gender Reveal, Inc.
posts.tagline: Turn your gender reveal into a friends & family round
posts.description: Launch your baby like a real startup. Create a gender reveal page, add personalized gifts for your little human, and let friends chip in for an early reveal. Everyone else finds out on the public reveal date. Your baby gets the keepsakes. You get a head start. Try the interactive demo and join the waitlist for December 24.

posts.name: Chat to Markdown
posts.tagline: Your AI chats saved as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder
posts.description: Chat to Markdown is a Chrome extension that saves your ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini chats as Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault or any folder. Each chat becomes onemd file with properties and tags, and it's updated when you continue the chat, without duplicates and without touching notes you added. It also saves Copilot, Perplexity, Grok and DeepSeek chats, images and files included. Chats go straight to your disk, never through a server. Free for 10 chats, Pro saves them all.

posts.name: HRthroo
posts.tagline: AI screening, phone screens and video interviews for hiring
posts.description: HRthroo takes the first pass of hiring off your recruiters. It screens every CV against the job and shows the evidence behind each score, phone-screens shortlisted candidates in their own language from your own number, and runs proctored AI video interviews. Clients get an expiring shortlist link instead of a zip of CVs. Built in New Delhi for recruitment agencies and companies hiring at volume.

posts.name: Nutrition Counts
posts.tagline: How much you eat, and how good it is
posts.description: A free food scanner and tracker in one app. Scan a barcode for a score out of 100 with the reasons behind it, then log your day to see the quality of your calories, not just the count. Made for the UK, works worldwide. iPhone and Android.

posts.name: ChatGPT and Claude conversation exporter
posts.tagline: Export any ChatGPT & Claude chat in one click
posts.description: Export your ChatGPT and Claude conversations in one click. Save AI conversations as PDF, PNG, Markdown, TXT, CSV, or JSON. Easily archive important chats, save research, document AI workflows, and share useful conversations. Everything works directly in your browser. Your conversations are never uploaded to external servers. Simple, fast, and privacy-focused. Keep your AI conversations whenever you need them.

posts.name: Drivay
posts.tagline: Book parking spaces nearby, or earn from your empty one
posts.description: Drivay is a marketplace for parking spaces in India, starting in Bengaluru. Need parking? Book a private parking space near where you're going (a spot, garage, driveway or lot) by the hour, day or month, pay in the app and get turn-by-turn directions. Have a parking space you don't use? List it in a few minutes, choose when it's available and what it costs, and get paid after every booking. Societies and parking-lot operators can list too.

posts.name: Resource Pack Studio
posts.tagline: Design your Minecraft server's resource pack in the browser
posts.description: Resource Pack Studio is a browser design studio for Minecraft Java servers. Draw chest menus that work like a shop, pixel rank tags for chat and TAB, items with their own ID and animation, custom blocks, pixel fonts and your server list entry. Style names and lore freely in MiniMessage, check everything at game size, then build it all into one resource pack that players get when they join. Free for one server, no card needed.

posts.name: Streets: Track My Walk
posts.tagline: Track every street you’ve walked in your city
posts.description: Streets records your walks with GPS, highlights the streets you’ve covered on a map, and shows your progress across the city. Find a nearby street you haven’t walked yet and take a different turn on your next walk.

posts.name: Calladhere
posts.tagline: AI Call Compliance Software for Medicare & ACA
posts.description: AI call compliance auditing for Medicare and ACA insurance agencies: every call scored automatically against your compliance criteria, violation review with timestamped transcript evidence, corrective actions, agent performance, and compliance reporting.

posts.name: TravCozy
posts.tagline: Forward a booking email. Get one itinerary.
posts.description: Your complete travel itinerary, organized and always up to date. Import bookings from anywhere and manage all your trips in one beautiful app.

posts.name: Justify
posts.tagline: The measurement-first platform for influencer marketing
posts.description: The measurement-first platform for influencer marketing: find, check and pay influencers, then see what each campaign did and sold.

posts.name: Qualis Insights AssetIQ
posts.tagline: Identify savings opportunities across your vendor portfolio
posts.description: AssetIQ helps organizations identify vendor rationalization opportunities, reduce unnecessary spend, and optimize supplier portfolios. Analyze vendors, uncover overlaps, track savings initiatives, and make data-driven sourcing decisions from one platform.

posts.name: Hala AI
posts.tagline: AI agents for calls, WhatsApp, and customer messages
posts.description: Hala AI is a Lebanese-first, done-for-you AI customer communication platform developed by MetaEmpires. It answers calls and messages across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and websites, 24/7. Businesses use Hala to qualify leads, manage bookings, support customers, and automate follow-ups, with CRM and calendar integrations plus human handoff when needed. Built for natural conversations in Lebanese Arabic, other Arabic dialects, English, and French.

posts.name: CandiLyt
posts.tagline: AI CV screening that shows the proof behind every rank
posts.description: CandiLyt reads every CV against your job and ranks candidates into Interview first, Maybe and Unlikely fit. Each requirement is marked Supported, Partial or Gap, with the CV line that proves it. It writes interview questions from each candidate's gaps and keeps a one-page decision record. Names and contact details are removed before the AI reads a CV, and it never rejects anyone on its own. Works with email, apply links, Greenhouse, Lever and Zoho Recruit. First job free.

posts.name: Voicebid
posts.tagline: Multi-Model AI Voice Studio - Compare & Create Voiceovers
posts.description: Voicebid is a Multi-Model AI Voice Studio for creators, marketers, and brands, bringing 40+ speech models, 20K+ voices, and 100+ languages from leading voice labs like ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, HeyGen, Deepgram, Gemini & many more into one platform. Compare lets you hear the same script on multiple voices side by side before you spend for real. Studio generates voiceovers for videos, podcasts, ads, and more. One prepaid wallet gives pay-as-you-go access at list rates, no subscription lock-in.

posts.name: Qualis Insights MergeIQ
posts.tagline: Post-Merger Integration & Synergy Tracking Software
posts.description: MergeIQ helps organizations plan, execute, and track post-merger integrations. Manage initiatives, monitor synergy realization, align functional teams, and provide executives with visibility into integration progress and value capture.

posts.name: BrowserGames.life
posts.tagline: Discover games. Share your favorites. Connect with gamers
posts.description: Social discovery platform for browser, PC, mobile, and console games — play, curate, and discuss.

posts.name: QuietJar
posts.tagline: A donation button that goes quiet once the goal is met
posts.description: An embeddable donation button built around goals that end. Set a goal for a real cost, supporters cover it in a couple of taps on your own site, and the button steps aside until the next goal.

posts.name: Kafkai
posts.tagline: Competitor Keywords & Backlinks, Read by Your AI
posts.description: Ask your AI about any site: the keywords it ranks for, who links to it, what to write next. Works with Claude and ChatGPT. 1,000 free credits, no card.

posts.name: PerfOS
posts.tagline: AI that creates, launches and optimizes your Meta Ads 24/7.
posts.description: PerfOS turns a short brief into ready-to-run Meta ads: images, copy and ad sets for Facebook and Instagram. It publishes them, watches results every day, pauses ads that don't work and collects leads. For small businesses and agencies. Fire your agency. Hire PerfOS.

posts.name: Cortex-Compta
posts.tagline: Swiss accounting extraction & export for fiduciaries
posts.description: Cortex-Compta is a Swiss web software for fiduciaries and SMEs. Extract data from scanned invoices and Swiss QR-bills, apply Swiss VAT, and export clean journals to Crésus, Winbiz, Bexio, Abacus, Sage, or Banana. 30-day free trial (100 pages), no card.
